newsitem.title: USA: Pharmhouse urged to retain investment bank.
newsitem.headline: Pharmhouse urged to retain investment bank.

text.p: WisdomTree Associates L.P. advised Pharmhouse Corp's board to retain an independent investment bank to help improve its financial standing, the shareholder disclosed Tuesday in a regulatory filing.

In a letter written January 13 to Pharmhouse, WisdomTree said the bank could explore the availability of one or more extraordinary transactions designed to improve Pharmhouse's financial structure and/or industry position.
WisdomTree said it has no objection to the company's immediate intention to secure several million dollars of additional financing.

But, "We believe financial solutions should be considered by substantial and sophisticated investment professionals, against all other specific alternatives, and in concert with a broad financial plan for Pharmhouse's future," it said.
As of January 10, WisdomTree held a 9.8 percent stake in Pharmhouse, or 229,000 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, WisdomTree said its latest transactions include the purchase of 21,500 common shares between November 27 and December 31 at prices ranging from $7.51 to $9.20 per share.
